We are praying for the loved ones, fellow deputies, and everyone at the Charleston County Sheriff's Department grieving the loss of Deputy Michael Hendricks, who was killed in a line-of-duty tragedy yesterday.

Deputy Hendricks put on the badge to protect this community, and he gave everything doing it. 

May God give his family strength, peace, and comfort in the days ahead.

Rest in peace, Deputy Hendricks. Your sacrifice will never be forgotten💙

The internet broke after Carlos Alcaraz took off his shirt following a U.S. Open match.

SportsCenter posted the crowd’s response, women reached for their phones, and we discovered a remarkable new rule: the sexualization of a young athlete is only offensive when the athlete is female and the audience is male.

You don't get to condemn the male gaze and then celebrate the female one.

Real men protect women. Real women protect men.

Read the full op-ed: https://t.co/A0KYDRDRdA
